panels.description: Count of node pool creates started in the trailing 5 minutes, evaluated at each point on the graph. Reflects whichever create attempt the backend's informer processed last for this resource on its most recent relist/resync -- not guaranteed to be the temporally most recent attempt, since informer iteration order is unordered (see operation_phase_metrics_controller.go:42-50).

targets.expr: count by (cluster) (max by (cluster, environment, region, subscription_id, resource_id, resource_type, operation_type, phase) (backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) > (time() - 300)) or (count by (cluster) (max by (cluster, environment, region, subscription_id, resource_id, resource_type, operation_type, phase) (backend_resource_operation_start_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"})) * 0)

panels.title: Create Attempts Started (per 5m)

panels.description: Rate of items added to the NodePool controller workqueue. Covers create, update, and delete reconciles combined (the workqueue has no operation_type label) — a broader load signal alongside the create-specific attempts panel.

targets.expr: sum by (name, cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (rate(workqueue_adds_total{namespace="aro-hcp", name=~".*NodePool.*"}[5m])))

panels.title: NodePool Controller Reconcile Rate (Traffic Proxy — All Op Types)

panels.description: aro-hcp-backend pod CPU usage as a percentage of requested CPU. The backend service processes node pool create reconciliation; sustained high usage here saturates the create journey. Inlined raw query pending a dedicated sli:backend:saturation_cpu recording rule (see frontend-slo.json for that pattern). Proposed threshold: 85%.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (max without (prometheus_replica) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="aro-hcp", pod=~"aro-hcp-backend-.*", container!="", container!="POD"}[5m]))) / sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="aro-hcp", pod=~"aro-hcp-backend-.*", resource="cpu", job="kube-state-metrics"})) * 100

panels.title: Backend CPU Utilization (vs request)

panels.description: aro-hcp-backend pod memory working set as a percent of request. Backend has no memory limit configured, so this compares against request instead of limit like the CPU panel does. Proposed threshold: 85%.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (max without (prometheus_replica) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="aro-hcp", pod=~"aro-hcp-backend-.*", container!="", container!="POD"})) / sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{namespace="aro-hcp", pod=~"aro-hcp-backend-.*", resource="memory", job="kube-state-metrics"})) * 100

panels.title: Backend Memory Utilization (vs request)

panels.description: Node pool controller workqueue depth. A growing queue means the controller can't keep up with incoming work (create/update/delete combined) — a saturation signal for the component that drives node pool creation. Alert threshold: > 10 for 5 minutes.

targets.expr: max by (name, cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (workqueue_depth{namespace="aro-hcp", name=~".*NodePool.*"}))

panels.title: NodePool Controller Workqueue Depth

panels.description: aro-hcp-backend available replicas as a percent of desired. Same available/desired ratio pattern used by the frontend's ready SLI (sli:frontend:ready:ratio5m). A drop here means the controller has less capacity to process node pool creates.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{namespace="aro-hcp", deployment="aro-hcp-backend"})) / sum by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas{namespace="aro-hcp", deployment="aro-hcp-backend"})) * 100

panels.title: Backend Replicas Available

panels.description: aro-hcp-backend container restarts in the trailing hour, fleet-wide by cluster. Any restart during an active create is worth checking -- it can silently stall or duplicate a reconcile.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (max without(prometheus_replica) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace="aro-hcp", pod=~"aro-hcp-backend-.*"}[1h])))

panels.title: Backend Pod Restarts (1h)

panels.description: Distribution of node pools across all provisioning states over time (fleet-wide, not create-scoped).

targets.expr: count by (phase, cluster) (max by (cluster, environment, region, subscription_id, resource_id, phase) (backend_nodepool_provision_state == 1))

panels.title: Node Pools by Provisioning State

panels.description: Failed or canceled create attempts in the selected window, grouped by subscription. Shows as "No data" when there are zero failures, not an error. Reflects whichever create attempt the backend's informer processed last for this resource on its most recent relist/resync -- not guaranteed to be the temporally most recent attempt, since informer iteration order is unordered (see operation_phase_metrics_controller.go:42-50).

targets.expr: count by (subscription_id) ((max by (cluster, environment, region, subscription_id, resource_id, resource_type, operation_type, phase) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) == 1) and ((time() - max by (cluster, environment, region, subscription_id, resource_id, resource_type, operation_type, phase) (backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"})) < $__range_s))

panels.title: Failed / Canceled Create Attempts by Subscription (Window)

panels.description: Terminal node pool create attempts that completed within the selected dashboard time window. Shows resource ID, subscription, and terminal phase -- including canceled, unlike the Completed/Successful Creates stat panels above, which exclude canceled from the SLO denominator. This table's row count can be higher than those stats for that reason; it is a full drill-down view, not an SLO number. Reflects whichever create attempt the backend's informer processed last for this resource on its most recent relist/resync -- not guaranteed to be the temporally most recent attempt, since informer iteration order is unordered (see operation_phase_metrics_controller.go:42-50).

targets.expr: (max by (cluster, environment, region, subscription_id, resource_id, resource_type, operation_type, phase) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) == 1) and ((time() - max by (cluster, environment, region, subscription_id, resource_id, resource_type, operation_type, phase) (backend_resource_operation_last_transition_time_seconds{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"succeeded|failed|canceled", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"})) < $__range_s)

panels.title: Terminal Create Attempts (Window)

panels.description: All active node pool create operations across the fleet. Shows resource ID, subscription, and current phase. Shows as "No data" when nothing is currently in flight, not an error. Reflects whichever create attempt the backend's informer processed last for this resource on its most recent relist/resync -- not guaranteed to be the temporally most recent attempt, since informer iteration order is unordered (see operation_phase_metrics_controller.go:42-50).

targets.expr: max by (cluster, environment, region, subscription_id, resource_id, resource_type, operation_type, phase) (backend_resource_operation_phase_info{resource_type="$resource_type", operation_type="create", phase=~"accepted|provisioning|updating|deleting", subscription_id!~"${exclude_subs:raw}"}) == 1

panels.title: Active Create Operations (Details)
